senses.gloss:
इङ्ग् €1 U. (इङ्गति-ते, इङ्गितुम्, इङ्गित)
—1 To move, shake, be agitated; यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते Bg. 6. 19, 14. 23;
 त्वया सृष्टमिदं विश्वं यच्चेङ्गं यच्च नेङ्गति Mb. 3. 102. 20.
—2 To go, move. ━Caus.
—1 To move, agitate, shake.
—2 (In gram.) to separate the members of a compound; cf. इङ्ग्य below.

इङ्ग a.
—1 Movable; त्वया सृष्टमिदं विश्वं यच्चेङ्गं यच्च नेङ्गति Mb. 3. 102. 20.
—2 Wonderful, surprising.

इङ्ग + .{@-गः@}
—1 A hint or sign.
—2 An indication of a sentiment by gesture.
—3 Knowledge.

इङ्गनम् [इङ्ग्-ल्युट्]
—1 Moving, shaking, causing to move.
—2 Knowledge.
—3 The operation of separating one member of a compound from another,
 as by an Avagraha.

इङ्गित + .{@-तम्@} [भावे-क्त]
—1 Palpitation, shaking.
—2 Internal thought, inward thought or secret aim, intention, purpose;
 ˚आकारवेदिभिः K. 7; Pt. 1. 43; अगूढसद्भावमितीङ्गितज्ञया Ku. 5. 62;
 तस्य संवृतमन्त्रस्य गूढाकारेङ्गितस्य च R. 1. 20; Śi. 9. 69.
—3 A hint, sign, gesture; आकारैरिङ्गितैर्गत्या Pt. 1. 44.
—4 Particularly, the gesture or motion of the various limbs of the body
 indicating oneʼs intentions; gesture suited to betray internal feelings;
 आकारैरिङ्गितैर्गत्या गृह्यतेऽन्तर्गतं मनः Ms. 8. 26. cf. इङ्गितं
 हृद्गतो भावो बहिराकार आकृतिः । सज्जनः
.━{@Comp.@}: इङ्गितकोविद, इङ्गितज्ञ

इङ्गित + -कोविद, -ज्ञ a. skilled in the interpretation of internal
 sentiments by external gestures, understanding signs.

इङ्गित + -कोविद, -ज्ञ a. skilled in the interpretation of internal
 sentiments by external gestures, understanding signs.

इङ्ग्य pot. p.
—1 Movable from its place.
—2 (In the Prātiśākhyas) A term for those words or parts of a compound
 which in certain grammatical operations may be separated from the preceding
 parts; a word which in the Pada-Pāṭha is divided by the Avagraha.

इङ्गुदः, -दी, इङ्गुलः
 N. of a medicinal tree, Terminalia Catappa (Mar.
 हिंगणबेट); इङ्गुदीपादपः सोऽयम् U. 1. 21; प्रस्निग्धाः क्वचिदिङ्गुदीफलभिदः
 सूच्यन्त एवोपलाः Ś. 1. 14.
